title: feat(deploy): slice 2 — unit rendering, dry-run plans, generation log, status/rollback logic (#5766)
body: ## Summary Slice 2 of issue #5766 (deploy tool v1), building on slice 1 (PR #6231, merged: `deployTargets` registry + `deploy list` + definition validation). Queue task 13021. What lands in `pkgs/deploy/deploy.py`: - **Systemd unit rendering** (`render_unit`) and a **launchd plist stub** (`render_plist`) from a registry definition. The rendered `ExecStart` / program path points at the service's per-service nix profile `current` link (`/nix/var/nix/profiles/per-service//current/`, design §4.1) — never at a bare store path — so a generation flip is a profile repoint and the rendered file is identical for every generation of the same definition. systemd argument/environment quoting escapes whitespace, quotes, backslashes, and doubles the `%`/`$` introducers. - **`deploy --dry-run`**: the ordered §4.1 activation plan (build → install next generation into the profile → write unit/plist → daemon-reload → restart only that unit → health check → flip back on failure → append to the generation log), with no side effects. - **Generation log** (design §4.6): append-only JSONL per target under the state dir (`--state-dir` / `$DEPLOY_STATE_DIR`), one record per activation event carrying generation id, source rev, artifact, timestamp, actor, action, result. Logs are never truncated (two generations always retained). - **`deploy status`**: folds the log into current/previous generations (a rollback event makes the generation it repointed to current) and reports the health verdict for the target's `healthCheck` URL, or that no check is defined. - **`rollback` command logic**: selects the previous *distinct* generation (repointing, never rebuilding) and is refused when fewer than two distinct generations were ever current. - Real activation — `nix-env` profile install, `systemctl` restart, health-check flip-back — is the next slice: the non-dry-run deploy/rollback paths say so explicitly and exit non-zero rather than pretending to have activated something. The remaining on-laptop E2E acceptance from issue #5766 also stays open there. ## Tests - New `pkgs/deploy/test_deploy_slice2.py` (21 tests, stdlib unittest): unit/plist rendering invariants, generation-log round-trip/fold/rollback-fold, plan ordering and flip-back step, rollback refusal cases, status formatting, and CLI subprocess cases (dry-run creates no state, real deploy refused, seeded-log status, unknown target). Oracle: design §4.1/§4.2/§4.6 + the issue text, named in the test module docstring. - New flake check `deploy-slice2-tests` in `lib/default.nix` next to `deploy-dupkeys-property`, running the new test file against `deploy.py` in CI. - Existing coverage re-verified locally on the laptop against the new `deploy.py`: `test_dupkeys_property.py` (300 cases, property holds), `deploy list` on a valid registry, malformed registry rejected with field-level errors, `status` on an empty log. Refs #5766 (issue stays open for the activation slice + E2E acceptance). --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
